book.name: 2 Timoti
book.title: Ŋwa wù kiŋgane kifɛɛ wù Bol gɛ̀ saŋ fɛ Timoti le

content: Bol teefɛ Timoti lɛ wu gêe lɛme che chuule
Njɛme finɛ wo le, a Nyo fwe bɛ Kletu Jiso wu lé wu sâ bamii ba baaŋ yu bɛ ba kweeyɛ wa. Njɛme nɛ nje mbunɛ we wù wu lé wu yû wu tô wu bûnɛ mo bvunfoŋ bwe njɛme lɛ,
wo fêeji jɛ yi Nyo. Wo fêeji gɛh wo gɛɛne yu fwe, kɛnɛ nyume kife ki kojɛ le kɛnɛ ki baaŋ kojɛ gɛ le. Wo dûunyi bajialɛ ba bamii lɛ, wo naji bo, wo yufe muntele muboo bɛ nyiɛgee no n'yɛyɛ wo le.

Wo kêe lɛ kife too lo ki bamii baaŋ gɛ bo lɛ̂me yi n'yɛyɛ wù kooji le gɛ. Bintuŋ biboo lé bi gê bi fûu ki bi yûge wa nyu fiɛɛ fimi yeye. Bo mo bo gôoŋ bamii ba n'yɛyɛ, bo le bo le, ba le bo yɛ̂yi wa nyu fiɛɛ fì bo koŋe ki bo yûge.
Bo lé bo chînɛ ki bo yûge nyume fiɛɛ fì nchiɛɛŋ le, bo shɛ̂ŋe bo gɛ̂ɛne gɛh nyume a mumaŋa mu achiji le.
Geenɛ, fɛ wo le, wo lêese kikwɛɛ kuŋ chaaŋ segechii, wo kâane shɛ́ŋ yi baŋgɛ le, wo gêe lɛme chi muh wu jiɛnyi lo wu feeji jɛ yi Nyo. Wo gêe lɛme chuŋ chichii chi ba le ba nya chiaaŋ yo le.
Fɛ mɛne, nle wa mɛɛse njɛ mbvuuŋ, kife kojɛ ka ki ba lé ba jô mɛ ba gê njɛ no ba to ba jo mbvuuŋ ba fu. Kife ki nle ŋkwɛɛ le ki kojɛ ka.
Nle n'ju wa bvuju bvu joŋe yi fiɛɛ fì Nyo le, nlege kinlegɛ mɛsɛ, njijɛ mbɛmɛ waŋ le mɛ gɛh yu.

Kɛge yi mɛɛse le ba gɛɛ wa kifo kaŋ ki bvunfoŋ ki le ki kinche kì chaaŋ. Kifo kinɛ le ki Tada wu le muh wù sage bansa chaaŋ, le wu wù lé wu bôoŋ ki a mɛ fwa yi juu chi kimɛsɛ le. Gɛ wu nyume wu booŋ gɛh nyume kaŋ maa gɛ. Wu lé wu bôoŋ tɛ bi bamii bachii ba chiɛɛne bo koŋe lɛ wu kâasɛ wu tô.
Bol sɛɛŋ no mwɛɛ le a kimbe ke le
Timoti, môoŋ chuule ki wo yâŋsɛ wo tô chige fɛ mɛne.
Wo kêe lɛ Dɛma le wu koŋ wa woŋ wu mɛɛse kfunɛ, wu noŋ mɛ wù gɛɛŋ Tɛsalonika. Klesɛŋ le wu gɛɛŋ Galɛshiaŋ, Taytu gɛɛŋ Dalmatia.
Mɛ gɛh Luka wu maa wu le besa wu. Sege wo too, wo jo Maliku bena wu too. Taŋlo wu fîi mɛ baaŋ yi lɛme le.
Tichiku, nle ntuŋ wu Ɛfɛsu.
Sege wo too, wo jo kikuŋ kaŋ kì baaŋ ki ŋgɛ ŋgɛlɛ a Kabu yeh a kilaantɛŋ ki Towa le. Wo tôo tɛ bɛ baŋwa baŋ, fede munchii mu ba fɛ bɛ je yi nyaŋ.
Alɛksanda wu suŋe kilamɛ le wu ge ŋgɛ bɛ mɛ, nyume gɛ wu wɛɛ gɛ. Tada lé wu lâŋɛ wu yi gee che le.
Wo yɛ̂ne tɛ bena wu. Wu tɛɛnyi baaŋ kune saaka wu besabɛŋ feeji wunɛ le.
Yi juu chi fwe le yi nsa waŋ le, chi ŋgɛ nto nlɛɛŋ yi tɛdɛ chi nsa le, muh gɛ̀ baaŋ lɛɛŋ gɛ a mɛ jiŋ gɛ. Bamii bachii gɛ̀ bee bo legɛ lo mɛ. Keefɛ Nyo sâ bo yi fi fiɛɛ le gɛ.
Geenɛ, Tada gɛ̀ lɛɛŋ a mɛ jiŋ, wu nya mɛ bɛ bvuŋga ki nfejɛ saaka wù joŋe chuule wu lɛ bamii bachii ba le gɛ Bajuu gɛ yu saaka wuyu. Noo, wu gɛ̀ be wu bvusɛ mɛ jwe wu bvule le.
Tada lé wu bvûuse gɛh mɛ chiaaŋ yi fiɛɛ fì befe le fichii, wu lé wu yû wu tô wu lêesɛ mɛ bvunfoŋ bwe bvu fɛwe le yi nyiɛŋgee le. Besabɛŋ bɛ̂ɛŋse wu segechii bee luu gɛ. Fi nyûme noo.
Ban'yɛsɛ
Yɛ̂sɛ Blisila bɛ Akwela le wo nya mɛne. Wo yɛ̂sɛ tɛ yeh yi Onesifolu le.
Ɛlastu gɛ̀ shɛɛ Kolɛŋ, Tofimu le ŋgɛ nchinɛ wu le Miletu wu chɛne.
Wo moŋ chuule ki wo tô fɛ nfuŋ wu tɛɛme ge wu kɛ. Yubulu chiiŋse n'yɛsɛ wo le. Budeŋ bɛ Lɛnu mo Klawdia bɛ booŋ ba bwee wese besabɛŋ bachii yi Kletu le chiiŋse tɛ n'yɛsɛ.
Nlɛge lɛ Tada nyûme bɛ kiyo kuŋ. Wu dûnyɛ fitele fì joŋe fɛ bɛŋ le bachii.
